extracted.name: White Chocolate Snack Mix
extracted.description: Here is a sweet-and-salty snack mix that is delicious and colorful. Don’t be afraid to mix it up: salted almonds, granola, or butterscotch chips would be fine substitutes or additions.
ingredient_lines: 1 (14 ounce) package candy-coated milk chocolate pieces
instruction_lines: Line 3 baking sheets with waxed paper or parchment. Set aside.
In a large bowl, combine mini pretzels, toasted oat cereal, crispy corn cereal squares, salted peanuts, and M&M’S. Set aside.
In a microwave-safe bowl, heat chips and oil on medium-high for 2 minutes, stirring once. Microwave on high for 10 seconds; stir until smooth. Pour over cereal mixture and mix well.
Spread onto prepared baking sheets. Cool; break apart. Store in an airtight container.
